eyebrow: Exercise 2: the failure case, N = 15, a = 14
code:
14^1=14  14^2=196 mod 15=1   -> r=2 (even)
a^(r/2) mod N = 14^1 mod 15 = 14
14 == -1 mod 15 (=14)  -> the flagged failure condition

gcd(14-1,15)=gcd(13,15)=1 (trivial)
gcd(14+1,15)=gcd(15,15)=15 (trivial)
caption: Both gcds come back trivial — every step was computed correctly; this is the predicted failure mode, not an error.
